_note: A second, deliberately different curriculum. Different day numbers, different domain, different module boundaries. It exists to prove the engine has no hardcoded coupling to the AI cohort: set CURRICULUM_PATH=curriculum.platform.json and everything still plans, asks and scores.

days.title: Toolchain & Shell Setup
objectives: Install and configure the platform toolchain
Set up reproducible shell environments per project
Verify the toolchain on a clean machine

days.title: Linux Fundamentals for Operators
objectives: Understand process lifecycle and service supervision
Diagnose a hung service from logs and open file handles
Explain how signals and exit codes propagate

days.title: Git Workflows & Trunk-Based Development
objectives: Implement a trunk-based branching workflow
Automate checks with pre-commit hooks
Recover a repository from a bad force-push

days.title: Terraform Core Concepts
objectives: Model infrastructure declaratively with Terraform
Explain state, drift and the plan/apply cycle
Structure modules for reuse across environments

days.title: Remote State & Locking
objectives: Configure remote state with locking
Recover from a stale lock without corrupting state
Separate state per environment safely

days.title: Secrets Management
objectives: Store and rotate secrets without committing them
Inject secrets into workloads at runtime
Audit who accessed which secret and when

days.title: Infrastructure Modules & Environments
objectives: Ship a reusable module consumed by two environments
Promote a change from staging to production safely
Document the module contract and its breaking changes

days.title: Container Images & Build Caching
objectives: Build minimal, reproducible container images
Use layer caching to cut build time
Scan images for known vulnerabilities before release

days.title: CI Pipelines
objectives: Build a pipeline that tests, builds and publishes artifacts
Make pipelines fast with caching and parallelism
Fail a pipeline loudly and usefully

days.title: Progressive Delivery
objectives: Implement canary and blue-green deployment strategies
Define automated rollback criteria from live metrics
Deploy a change to production with zero downtime

days.title: Reliability & Error Budgets
objectives: Define SLIs and SLOs for a real service
Explain how an error budget changes release decisions
Choose alert thresholds that do not page for noise

days.title: Observability & Incident Response
objectives: Instrument a service with traces, metrics and structured logs
Build a dashboard that answers a real on-call question
Run an incident and write a blameless postmortem

days.title: Performance & Cost Optimization
objectives: Load test a service and find its first bottleneck
Reduce infrastructure cost without hurting latency
Document measured before-and-after numbers

days.title: Capstone: Ship a Platform Service
objectives: Deliver a production service end to end with IaC and CI
Demonstrate rollback, alerting and on-call readiness
Present the architecture and its trade-offs
